2: ^Yes, cow was first\. This is a cat\.

messages.text: Look, Mouse sees a cat. Listen. Cat. /k/ /æ/ /t/ Cat. Your turn. Cat.[TEACHER_CAT_PAWS][TEACHER_LISTEN][STUDENT_TALK]
Yes, cow was first. This is a cat. Let's try again. Cat. Your turn. Cat.[TEACHER_LISTEN][STUDENT_TALK]
Yes, cat. A cat says meow meow. Listen. Meow meow. Your turn. Meow meow.[TEACHER_THUMBS_UP][TEACHER_CAT_PAWS][TEACHER_LISTEN][STUDENT_TALK]
Meow meow. You sound like a cat. Does the cat have the cake? Say yes or no.[TEACHER_LISTEN][STUDENT_TALK]
